exposure: Fetal middle cerebral artery pulsatility index
outcome: Emergency cesarean section for fetal distress
cohort: 164 women with normal umbilical artery Doppler recordings undergoing labor induction for estimated fetal weight <10th percentile
finding: Both a very unfavorable cervix (Bishop score <2) and an abnormal CPR were associated with an increased likelihood of emergency Cesarean section for fetal distress.
